text: Milieu [Fr.]. ENVIRONMENT (q.v., also for equivalents in other languages). Used as a biological term by Lamarck ( Philos . Zool ., 1809, ii. 4 ff.) and by Comte ( Syst . de politique positive , vi. 574) who expanded the meaning by the phrase milieu intellectuel, and applied in sociology by Taine. Cf. Barth, Philos . d . Gesch . als Sociol , i. 33. ( J.M.B. - F.H.G. )
